name: Monitor Engine Room
implementation_notes: engine_room_record/engine_room_detail local SQLite tables added to localSchema.ts (CREATE_ENGINE_ROOM_RECORD/CREATE_ENGINE_ROOM_DETAIL, appended to CREATE_TABLE_STATEMENTS) -- mirrors storage_tank_record/storage_tank_detail's shape, following the hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row) pattern. This station has 27 non-time_slot columns -- the LARGEST field count of any station in this project (task brief originally said 26; the backend migration -- ground truth per explicit instruction -- has 27; corrected here as a derived assumption) and 2 enum status columns (diesel_gen_1_status, diesel_gen_2_status), stored as plain TEXT locally (no CHECK constraint in SQLite local schema)

engineRoomRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Engine Room screens (067/077/087) in one file, same convention as storageTankRecordRepo.ts covering screens 066/076/086; its full unit test coverage (engineRoomRecordRepo.spec.ts, 30 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence
createDraft() inserts ONLY the header row -- engine_room_detail rows are added one at a time by the user in Form Engine Room via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring storageTankRecordRepo.ts's pattern
'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter is a plain COUNT(*) of engine_room_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no filled-row filter, mirrors Storage Tank's Monitor counter exactly

Router: route name 'monitor-engine-room' registered in router/index.ts -- StationListView.vue (screen-006) already had this route name pre-wired in MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES and an 'engine-room': false placeholder in draftStatusByType; this implementation wires the real engineRoomRecordRepo.getDrafts() call into StationListView.vue's Promise.all, replacing that placeholder with engineRoom.length > 0, same additive pattern Storage Tank used for this same pre-existing scaffolding

Added the missing getEngineRoomDraftsMock hoisted mock, vi.mock() registration, and getEngineRoomDraftsMock.mockResolvedValue([]) call in every beforeEach block of mobile/tests/StationListView.spec.ts (mirroring the existing getStorageTankDraftsMock pattern exactly) proactively, per explicit task instruction that a prior station's run omitted this and broke silently -- all 27 tests in that shared file pass

deferred_items.description: syncService.ts's syncAllRecords() was NOT extended with a syncEngineRoomRecords() function (unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank, which each have one calling POST /api/engine-room-records via the mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button)
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Storage Tank) made the same deferral decision for the same reason. The web POST/PATCH routes are already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role) so wiring this up later requires no backend route change, only a syncService.ts addition.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task (mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-engine-room.spec.ts does not exist) -- component test coverage (MonitorEngineRoomView.spec.ts) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's full navigation flow in a live dev server.
